description: Run independent attempts from one committed base, then choose a winner manually.
label: Best-of-N
clear: Turn off Best-of-N for the next send
title: Start {count} independent attempts
dirty: This checkout has uncommitted changes. They will not be carried into the attempts.
committedOnly: Attempts start from the committed SHA only. Uncommitted changes are never carried over.
manualOnly: You choose the winner manually. Picking early stops the other attempts. Publishing updates only the chosen local branch; nothing is pushed.
needsSession: Open a direct agent chat first.
needsRepository: Select a Git working directory for this conversation.
needsCommit: Commit the repository before starting best-of-N.
invalidPolicy: The committed acceptance policy is invalid. Fix it before starting best-of-N.
mixedBatch: /best-of-n must be the whole message. Send it on its own, without other commands.
busy: Wait for the current turn to finish before starting best-of-N.
textOnly: Best-of-N accepts a text prompt. Remove attachments and addressed runtime routes first.
useComposer: Run this command from the chat composer to preview the base and result branch.
noRun: This conversation has no best-of-N run.
candidateMissing: Choose a candidate number or exact candidate ID from this run.
picked: Candidate selected. Review its exact-head check results in the comparison before publishing.
unavailable: Best-of-N controls are available only on the local desktop Host. This device can view synced results.
externalCost: External agents do not report cost, so their cost is shown as unknown. A dollar budget cannot be enforced for them.
unknownAgent: No enabled agent matches "{agent}". Use session, an external agent configuration ID, or the preset of an enabled external agent.
stopRequested: Stop requested. The executing Host stops each attempt and syncs the result.
